purpose: Controlled first-pass listening comparison across the ten playable TES races and two adult gender presentations.
contentNotice: Fictional voice-design directions for a local listening trial. All samples share the same Southern English accent to isolate timbre; race-linked timbre cues are artistic test choices, not claims about Elder Scrolls canon or real-world racial voice traits.
fixedText: Good day, traveller. The road ahead is long, but you are welcome to rest here for a while.

trialControls.seedPolicy: Fixed, distinct integer seed per race and gender presentation; do not reroll failed or weak samples.
trialControls.accent: Southern English (identical across all samples; accent is not varied by race).
trialControls.isolationGoal: Compare race-associated timbre cues while holding text, emotion, delivery, and accent constant.
